items.question: What service credit applies when support tickets are answered late?
items.answer:
The documents do not specify what service credit applies when support tickets are answered late. The service credit provisions in the documents relate to the availability of the Services, not the response time for support tickets.

The relevant clauses state:
- "Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance" [1].
- "For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee" [1].
- "Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month" [1].

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: How much notice of a rent review must the landlord give?
items.answer:
The documents do not specify the amount of notice required for a rent review.

The lease includes a clause about a rent review on 1 April 2030, stating that the rent shall be reviewed to the open market rent, with the new rent not being less than the previous amount [1]. However, no specific notice period for this review is mentioned.

Other clauses in the lease discuss notice periods for breaking the lease, which is different from a rent review [2], but these do not apply to rent reviews.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: How much notice of a rent review must the landlord give?
items.answer:
The documents do not specify the amount of notice required for a rent review.
